name: BAD-Gaussians
definition: A method to recover a sharp 3D scene representation by jointly learning camera motion trajectories and Gaussian parameters from a sequence of motion-blurred images, inaccurate poses, and sparse point clouds estimated from COLMAP.
summary: BAD-Gaussians recovers sharp 3D scenes from motion-blurred images by jointly optimizing camera trajectories and Gaussian parameters, explicitly modeling physical blur formation unlike standard methods.
